ideas.pitch: An AI agent platform tailored for Kolkata IT and campus infrastructure that detects system anomalies during the graveyard shift and auto-generates pull requests.
ideas.title: GhostTrace: Autonomous Night-Shift Incident Responder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Halloween night-shift theme directly and follows the proven winning architecture of autonomous data incident response agents.

ideas.pitch: A localized collaborative coding workspace that merges simultaneous contributor streams for rapid multi-author hackathon prototyping.
ideas.title: HiveCode Kolkata: Real-Time Collaborative Vibe Coding
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the exact winning strategy of the Tech:Europe London Hackathon by focusing on social co-creation and modern developer experience.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent municipal waste management and dynamic routing dashboard optimized for urban block collection schedules in West Bengal.
ideas.title: EcoKolkata: Smart Ward Waste and IoT Bin Routing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on successful international hackathon patterns in smart civic management while offering clear local utility for municipal judges.

ideas.pitch: An ESP32-based impact detection and automated distress ping system designed for emergency response on large academic campuses.
ideas.title: AutoSOS GCELT: Post-Accident Campus IoT Alert System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins hardware and IoT track preference by solving tangible campus safety issues with immediate physical demonstration potential.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered workspace and hardware inventory management system for college labs that automates equipment checkout and real-time availability.
ideas.title: SpaceFlow Campus: Intelligent Lab and Equipment Booking
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies a proven runner-up enterprise workspace design to the direct operational needs of host institution GCELT's laboratories.
